ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with a low contrast ratio; high-intensity (light gray/white) pixels occupy approximately 10-15% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Light-gray mottling streaks oriented vertically on the medial-to-distal section of the right lobe; minimal high-intensity pixels on the left lobe, restricted to the medial trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped median notch with an obtuse angle estimated at 120-130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edges; higher frequency of irregularities observed on the right lobe trailing edge approaching the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the leading edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of dark, textured, protruding pixel groups (barnacle colonies) located on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biological encrustations (barnacles) localized on the extreme lateral tips of the fluke lobes.
